blocks.title: Welcome to Introduction to Trigonometry
blocks.title_hi: Introduction to Trigonometry में आपका स्वागत है
blocks.body: Before we dive in, let's look at a real-life example of this concept.
blocks.body_hi: इससे पहले कि हम शुरू करें, आइए इस अवधारणा का एक वास्तविक जीवन उदाहरण देखें।

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.body: In a right triangle, the opposite side is 3 and the hypotenuse is 5. Find sin θ.
blocks.body_hi: In a right triangle, the opposite side is 3 and the hypotenuse is 5. Find sin θ.

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.body: Find the value of sin 30° + cos 60°.
blocks.body_hi: Find the value of sin 30° + cos 60°.

blocks.title: Example 3
blocks.body: Find the value of 2 sin 45° × cos 45°.
blocks.body_hi: Find the value of 2 sin 45° × cos 45°.

blocks.title: Example 4
blocks.body: Find the value of sin²60° + cos²60°.
blocks.body_hi: Find the value of sin²60° + cos²60°.

blocks.title: Example 5
blocks.body: In a right triangle, the adjacent side is 12 and hypotenuse is 13. Find cos θ.
blocks.body_hi: In a right triangle, the adjacent side is 12 and hypotenuse is 13. Find cos θ.
